sample.title: REAL: voice -> Muse Spark vision -> verify (recorded calls)
sample.description: Real Meta tool calls recorded on 2026-11-02 (pure vision, agent tools off): speech transcription, then Muse Spark finds the named element on a synthetic GUI screenshot, then a deterministic check against the generator's ground truth. Synthetic screenshots, TTS speech, small n; replay shows the recorded timings, not a live run. The hit column uses a loose rule (IoU>=0.5 or click point inside the target box); no row reaches IoU 0.5 on its own.
chain: Aggregate over every task in the run
